findings.description: InProc session-based identity only. No JWT parsing, no OAuth2 token exchange, no on-behalf-of flow.
findings.gap: No identity propagation mechanism for agent-on-behalf-of-user scenarios.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT/OAuth-based identity propagation distinguishing agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.

findings.title: Plaintext Credentials in Configuration
findings.description: Database credentials embedded in plaintext in web.config (User ID=ts_app;Password=Time2006!). No secrets management, no rotation.
findings.gap: Hardcoded plaintext credentials with no rotation or encryption.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation. Remove plaintext credentials.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual identities. Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent.
findings.gap: No identity suspension mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent-identity revocation capability (API key deletion or IAM role deactivation).

findings.title: No Data Access Differentiation
findings.description: Employee timesheet data stored with no access control differentiation. Single database user can access all employee records. B2 fires: no access differentiation.
findings.gap: No access differentiation between sensitive data domains. Single permission grants access to all employee data.
findings.recommendation: Implement row-level security and OAuth scope differentiation for employee data access.

findings.title: Undocumented Data Residency
findings.description: No data residency documentation or configuration. Database at fixed IP (10.0.6.15) with no region/compliance context. Unknown whether sending employee data to LLM in another region violates regulations.
findings.gap: Unknown residency constraints for employee data. No compliance documentation.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Configure same-region LLM endpoints.

findings.title: No PII Redaction Controls — Error Pages Expose Data
findings.description: No PII redaction. customErrors disabled exposes sensitive data (employee IDs, SQL queries) in error pages. Debug mode enabled amplifies exposure.
findings.gap: No PII redaction controls. Error pages expose sensitive data.
findings.recommendation: Enable customErrors. Implement PII masking middleware when adding logging.

findings.title: No Pagination or Query Filtering
findings.description: BindGrid retrieves all records for an employee with no pagination, filtering, or result size limits. Results are unbounded.
findings.gap: No pagination, filtering, or result size limits.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination (limit/offset or cursor), date range filtering, and sorting to the API.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerable
findings.description: Zero input validation. User inputs concatenated directly into SQL statements. SQL injection vulnerability present. No type checking or sanitization.
findings.gap: Complete absence of input validation. SQL injection via string concatenation.
findings.recommendation: Replace string-concatenated SQL with parameterized queries. Implement schema-based input validation.

findings.title: Incomplete Temporal Metadata
findings.description: Schema includes entry_date but no created_at, updated_at, or event_time. No timezone handling. No freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Incomplete temporal metadata. No audit timestamps. No freshness signaling.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at and updated_at timestamps with UTC normalization to the data model.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema documentation, versioning, or API contracts. Database schema only visible through inline SQL strings.
findings.gap: Complete absence of schema versioning and contract management.
findings.recommendation: Document schema, implement migration tooling, add versioned API contracts.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual Visual Studio publish to network share on Windows Server 2003/IIS 6. No peer review, no drift detection.
findings.gap: Complete absence of infrastructure governance.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as code (Terraform/CDK) with PR-based review and drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD. Manual deployment. No automated testing or contract testing.
findings.gap: Complete absence of CI/CD and contract testing.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Manual file-copy deployment. No blue/green, no canary, no CodeDeploy.
findings.gap: No automated rollback mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback triggers (CodeDeploy, blue/green).

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. No unit tests, integration tests, or API tests.
findings.gap: Zero test coverage.
findings.recommendation: Implement comprehensive API test suite as part of new API layer development.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. SQL Server 2005 does not support TDE. No KMS keys configured.
findings.gap: Data at rest unencrypted. Database predates encryption support.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for SQL Server with KMS encryption at rest.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state. INSERT commits immediately with no intermediate reviewable state.
findings.gap: All write operations immediately committed with no reviewable intermediate state.
findings.recommendation: Add status-based lifecycle (DRAFT → PENDING → APPROVED) to timesheet entries.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates. All operations execute immediately upon form submission.
findings.gap: No mechanism to require human approval for specific operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for agent-initiated write operations.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Single-server production deployment with no non-production environments.
findings.gap: No safe environment for agent testing.
findings.recommendation: Create sandbox environment with synthetic timesheet data.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing, no OpenTelemetry, no X-Ray, no structured logging, no correlation IDs. Zero observability instrumentation.
findings.gap: Complete absence of observability.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry SDK with X-Ray and structured JSON logging with correlation IDs.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No alerting. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no monitoring integration.
findings.gap: Complete absence of alerting.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms on API error rates and P95 latency.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no conditional writes. Multiple agents can submit overlapping entries with no conflict detection.
findings.gap: Complete absence of concurrency controls.
findings.recommendation: Add version fields and optimistic locking. Implement ETag-based concurrency in API layer.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF, no application middleware. Runaway agent loop could overwhelm SQL Server.
findings.gap: Complete absence of rate limiting.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and throttling before exposing endpoints to agents.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. Agent could submit unlimited timesheet entries with no per-session or per-caller caps.
findings.gap: No business-domain caps on operation scope.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-agent transaction limits (e.g., max_entries_per_day).

findings.title: State Only Queryable Through WebForms UI
findings.description: BindGrid provides read-before-write capability but only through browser UI interaction, not programmatic API.
findings.gap: State queryable only through WebForms UI, not programmatic API.
findings.recommendation: Expose GET endpoints for timesheet state in the new API layer.

findings.title: Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Error handling uses plain throw new Error('forbidden: requires scope ...') with no custom error codes or retryable indicators. Agents cannot distinguish authorization failures from other errors without string parsing.
findings.gap: No custom error codes, no retryable boolean, no structured error classification.
findings.recommendation: Use Apollo GraphQLError with explicit codes and retryable boolean in extensions.

findings.title: Identity Propagation and Delegation
findings.description: The system extracts JWT scope claims but does not extract or utilize the sub or client_id claims. No mechanism to distinguish an agent acting under its own service identity versus acting on behalf of a human user.
findings.gap: No on-behalf-of flow, no token exchange pattern, no distinction between machine-client and user-delegated JWT tokens.
findings.recommendation: Extract sub and client_id from JWT claims in the context builder. Use client_id presence to distinguish machine callers from user callers.

findings.title: Temporal Metadata and Freshness
findings.description: Products have updatedAt (ISO 8601) but no createdAt, no freshness/staleness signaling, no consistency-level indication in responses.
findings.gap: No createdAt timestamp, no Cache-Control headers, no consistency signaling.
findings.recommendation: Add createdAt field. Document DynamoDB consistency behavior in schema descriptions.

findings.title: Schema Versioning and API Contracts
findings.description: GraphQL schema is documented and machine-readable but not versioned. No breaking change detection, no consumer-driven contract tests, no changelog.
findings.gap: No schema versioning strategy, no breaking change detection in CI.
findings.recommendation: Integrate graphql-inspector into CI for breaking change detection. Add schema version tagging.

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance
findings.description: Infrastructure is defined as code (SAM template.yaml). No evidence of peer review enforcement and no drift detection configuration.
findings.gap: IaC present (1/3). No PR review enforcement (0/3). No drift detection (0/3).
findings.recommendation: Add CI pipeline with sam validate on PRs. Enable CloudFormation drift detection.

findings.title: CI/CD with API Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline configuration exists in the repository. No automated testing or breaking change detection before production.
findings.gap: No CI/CD pipeline, no contract testing, no schema validation in build.
findings.recommendation: Add CI pipeline with npm test, npm run lint, sam validate, and graphql-inspector diff.

findings.title: Rollback Capability
findings.description: No deployment rollback configuration. No blue/green, canary, CodeDeploy, or traffic shifting. Default all-at-once Lambda deployment.
findings.gap: No automated rollback on deployment failure.
findings.recommendation: Add AutoPublishAlias and DeploymentPreference (Canary10Percent5Minutes) to Lambda in SAM template.

findings.title: API Test Coverage
findings.description: Vitest is configured as test runner but no test files exist in the repository. Zero automated test coverage for the GraphQL API.
findings.gap: No test files. No integration tests, contract tests, or unit tests.
findings.recommendation: Add vitest integration tests for resolvers: valid queries, mutations with proper/improper scopes, pagination, error responses.

findings.title: Draft/Pending State
findings.description: All mutations commit immediately. upsertProduct writes directly to DynamoDB and deleteProduct immediately sets active=false. No draft, pending, or proposed state for human review.
findings.gap: No PENDING/DRAFT status field, no two-step commit, no approval workflow.
findings.recommendation: Add status enum (draft/active/archived) to Product schema. Agent writes set status to draft; human confirms promotion to active.

findings.title: Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gate mechanism exists. All operations execute immediately upon valid JWT with required scope. No configurable per-operation approval flags.
findings.gap: No approval API endpoints, no configurable operation-level gates.
findings.recommendation: Introduce configuration-driven approval gate via SSM Parameter Store with per-operation approval requirements.

findings.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No evidence of separate staging or sandbox environment. SAM template is parameterized but no multi-environment config, Docker Compose, or seed data exists.
findings.gap: No staging/sandbox environment definition, no local development setup.
findings.recommendation: Create samconfig.toml with environment-specific overrides. Add docker-compose.yml with DynamoDB Local.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing and Structured Logging
findings.description: X-Ray tracing is Active (SAM Globals). However, no structured logging library is implemented — no JSON formatter, no correlation ID propagation in application logs.
findings.gap: No structured logging with correlation IDs in application code. Tracing present but logging absent.
findings.recommendation: Add @aws-lambda-powertools/logger for structured JSON logs with X-Ray trace ID correlation.

findings.title: Alerting on Error Rates and Latency
findings.description: No alerting configuration exists. No CloudWatch alarms for error rates, latency, or throttling on the Lambda or API Gateway.
findings.gap: No alerting thresholds configured for the agent-facing API.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for Lambda error rate > 5%, p99 latency > 5s, DynamoDB throttled requests > 0.

findings.title: Concurrency Controls
findings.description: The upsertProduct mutation uses unconditional PutItem and deleteProduct uses unconditional UpdateItem. No optimistic locking, version fields, or conditional expressions. Concurrent writes result in last-write-wins with no conflict detection.
findings.gap: No version field, no DynamoDB ConditionExpression on writes, no ETag/If-Match support.
findings.recommendation: Add a version field to products and use DynamoDB ConditionExpression on writes for optimistic locking.

findings.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
findings.description: No circuit breaker pattern implemented. AWS SDK v3 provides default retry logic and Lambda has 30s timeout, but no circuit breaker to fast-fail during sustained DynamoDB degradation.
findings.gap: No circuit breaker library wrapping DynamoDB calls. No fallback behavior during sustained failures.
findings.recommendation: Add a circuit breaker wrapper (cockatiel or opossum) around DynamoDB calls with structured 503 response during open state.

findings.title: Rate Limiting and Throttling
findings.description: No rate limiting is configured at any layer. The SAM HttpApi has no throttling settings, no WAF rules, no usage plan. A runaway agent loop could invoke the endpoint at machine speed.
findings.gap: No API Gateway throttling, no WAF rate rules, no per-caller request limits.
findings.recommendation: Add ThrottlingBurstLimit and ThrottlingRateLimit to SAM HttpApi DefaultRouteSettings. Deploy WAF rate-based rule.

findings.title: Blast Radius and Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable limits on agent-initiated actions. Each mutation operates on a single product, but no per-session or per-caller caps on total mutations. An agent loop could modify thousands of products.
findings.gap: No max-operations-per-session, no per-caller business transaction limits.
findings.recommendation: Add per-caller mutation counter with configurable threshold (e.g., max 100 mutations per hour per caller).

findings.title: Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses include structured JSON with code and message fields but lack a retryable indicator or error category.
findings.gap: No retryable boolean or error category. Agent cannot determine retry strategy from response body.
findings.recommendation: Extend error schema to include retryable boolean and error category.

findings.title: Identity Propagation and Delegation
findings.description: JWT tokens verified with issuer/audience validation but no on-behalf-of flow exists. No distinction between agent acting under own identity vs. on behalf of a user.
findings.gap: No identity propagation through service calls. No actor/user distinction.
findings.recommendation: Implement separate OAuth2 client credentials for agent identities with distinct JWT claims (actor_type, on_behalf_of).

findings.title: Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No mechanism for immediate agent identity suspension. JWT-only auth with no token denylist or per-agent disable mechanism.
findings.gap: Cannot suspend a specific agent identity without affecting all tokens signed by the same key.
findings.recommendation: Add a token denylist (Redis or DynamoDB) checked in auth middleware, or implement OAuth2 token introspection.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Classification
findings.description: Stage A: System stores customer-identifiable data. Stage B: B1 CLEAR (no credentials exposed in API), B2 RISK-SAFETY (single orders:read scope grants access to all order data for all customers — no data-domain differentiation), B3 INFO (no formal classification metadata).
findings.gap: B2: No access control differentiation between sensitive and non-sensitive data domains.
findings.recommendation: Introduce granular OAuth scopes differentiating metadata from financial data. Implement row-level security for customer segmentation.

findings.title: PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: CloudWatch logging configured with no PII masking middleware. CustomerId and order data could appear in error logs. No log scrubbing, no CloudWatch data protection policies.
findings.gap: No PII redaction in logging pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Add Fastify logger serializer that redacts PII fields. Consider CloudWatch Log data protection policies.

findings.title: Input Validation and Schema Enforcement
findings.description: No input validation libraries. Request bodies cast with TypeScript 'as' assertions without runtime validation. No structured validation error responses.
findings.gap: No runtime input validation at API boundary. Malformed payloads accepted without rejection.
findings.recommendation: Add @sinclair/typebox or zod for runtime validation with Fastify schema support.

findings.title: Temporal Metadata and Freshness
findings.description: No temporal fields (created_at, updated_at) in Order entity. No freshness headers in API responses.
findings.gap: No timestamps. Agents cannot determine data currency.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at/updated_at columns and Last-Modified response headers.

findings.title: Schema Versioning and API Contracts
findings.description: OpenAPI spec has version 2.1.0 but no runtime versioning enforcement, no breaking change detection tools, and no contract tests.
findings.gap: No versioning strategy enforced at runtime. No breaking change detection in CI.
findings.recommendation: Add URL prefix versioning and integrate oasdiff in CI for breaking change detection.

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance
findings.description: IaC exists (CloudFormation in infra/ecs.yaml) but no peer review enforcement or drift detection configured.
findings.gap: IaC present but no governance controls beyond definition.
findings.recommendation: Add AWS Config drift detection and PR review requirements for infra/ changes.

findings.title: CI/CD with API Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline configuration in repository. Build/test/lint scripts exist in package.json but no automation runs them.
findings.gap: No CI/CD pipeline. No automated contract testing or breaking change detection.
findings.recommendation: Add CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or GitLab CI) that runs build, test, lint, and OpenAPI validation on PRs.

findings.title: API Test Coverage
findings.description: Vitest configured as test framework but no test files exist in repository. Zero API test coverage.
findings.gap: No test files. No API tests validating endpoint behavior.
findings.recommendation: Write Vitest integration tests for all endpoints covering valid/invalid inputs, auth failures, and error responses.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No KMS encryption configuration for data store. RDS not provisioned in this CloudFormation template. Encryption status of external database unknown.
findings.gap: Encryption at rest status unknown for PostgreSQL database.
findings.recommendation: Document or configure encryption for the external RDS instance (StorageEncrypted: true with KMS key).

findings.title: Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state for agent-proposed writes. All write operations commit immediately. Order status values (placed, shipped, cancelled, refunded) have no PENDING_REVIEW or PROPOSED state.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent to propose changes for human review before execution.
findings.recommendation: Add pending status values (pending_refund, pending_cancel, pending_delete) for agent-initiated destructive operations.

findings.title: Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No operations require human approval. DELETE, refund, and cancel endpoints execute immediately upon receiving a valid authenticated request.
findings.gap: No configurable approval gates on high-risk operations.
findings.recommendation: Add per-operation approval configuration with threshold-based gates (e.g., refund > $100 requires approval).

findings.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment configuration. No docker-compose, no environment-specific IaC, no seed data.
findings.gap: No safe environment for agent testing without risk to live systems.
findings.recommendation: Create docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL and seed data for local agent testing.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing and Structured Logging
findings.description: CloudWatch logging configured but no distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, X-Ray), no trace ID propagation, and no correlation IDs.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing. No correlation IDs linking log entries for a single request.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry SDK or AWS X-Ray instrumentation with request correlation IDs.

findings.title: Alerting on Error Rates and Latency
findings.description: No alerting thresholds configured. No CloudWatch Alarms in IaC. Error rate and latency degradation would not trigger automated alerts.
findings.gap: No automated alerting for error rates or latency on agent-facing APIs.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch Alarms for ALB 5xx rate and p99 latency to CloudFormation template.

findings.title: Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, version fields, ETags, or SELECT FOR UPDATE patterns. Multiple concurrent agent instances could silently overwrite each other's changes.
findings.gap: No concurrency controls on write operations. Race conditions possible.
findings.recommendation: Add a version column to the orders table and implement optimistic locking in UPDATE queries.

findings.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
findings.description: External calls to WarehouseClient (issueRefund, recallDispatch) have no circuit breaker, retry logic, or timeout configuration.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns on external dependency calls. Failures cascade directly.
findings.recommendation: Wrap WarehouseClient calls with circuit breaker (opossum) and configure timeouts with exponential backoff.

findings.title: Rate Limiting and Throttling
findings.description: No rate limiting configured at any layer. No rate limiting middleware, no API Gateway throttling, no WAF rate rules. SAFETY.md explicitly identifies this gap.
findings.gap: No rate limiting. An agent loop could overwhelm the service at machine speed.
findings.recommendation: Add @fastify/rate-limit plugin and/or API Gateway throttling configuration.

findings.title: Blast Radius and Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. No caps on refund amounts, delete operations, or bulk operation sizes per session or caller.
findings.gap: No per-caller business transaction limits. Unlimited refunds/deletes possible.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent-identity transaction limits: max refund per hour, max deletions per day.

findings.title: Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses include a structured Error schema with code, message, and correlation_id fields. HTTP status codes are semantically appropriate (409, 422, 404). However, no explicit retryable boolean or retry category is included.
findings.gap: No retryable indicator in error responses. Agents must infer retryability from HTTP status codes alone.
findings.recommendation: Add a retryable boolean field to the Error schema. Map: 409→false, 422→false, 404→false, 5xx→true, 429→true.

findings.title: Identity Propagation and Delegation
findings.description: The system supports machine identity via OAuth2 client credentials with client_id attribution. However, it does not support on-behalf-of flows — there is no mechanism to distinguish between an agent acting under its own service identity vs. acting on behalf of a specific human user.
findings.gap: No identity propagation (JWT token exchange, on-behalf-of flow, X-User-Id headers). A payments service processing charges on behalf of users cannot attribute actions to the originating user through the authorization chain.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange or on-behalf-of flow via Cognito, adding a user identity claim to the token that the authorizer extracts alongside client_id. Log both actor (agent) and subject (user) in audit records.

findings.title: Schema Versioning and API Contracts
findings.description: OpenAPI spec versioned (1.4.0), URL path versioning (/v1/), CI validation. No breaking change detection in pipeline.
findings.gap: No automated breaking change detection in CI. An API change removing a field would pass CI without alerting consumers.
findings.recommendation: Add an OpenAPI diff step to GitHub Actions workflow (e.g., oasdiff breaking) that fails on backwards-incompatible changes.

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance for Agent-Facing Surface
findings.description: Agent-facing surface fully defined as IaC (SAM template). GitHub Actions CI implies PR-based review. No drift detection configured.
findings.gap: No infrastructure drift detection. Manual changes to deployed stack would not be detected.
findings.recommendation: Add AWS Config rules or scheduled CloudFormation drift detection.

findings.title: CI/CD with API Contract Testing
findings.description: CI pipeline includes OpenAPI spec validation, linting, type-checking, and pytest. Behavioral contract tests prove idempotency. No breaking change detection or consumer-driven contract testing.
findings.gap: No automated detection of API-breaking changes before production.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenAPI breaking-change detection step to CI pipeline. Consider Pact for consumer-driven contracts.

findings.title: API Test Coverage
findings.description: Three behavioral tests cover idempotent retry, conflict detection, and scope enforcement. Limited test breadth — no coverage of validation errors, not-found, refund flow, or edge cases.
findings.gap: No tests for validation error responses (422), not-found (404), refund flow, or boundary conditions.
findings.recommendation: Add test cases for validation errors, GET not-found, refund_charge flow, and missing Idempotency-Key rejection.

findings.title: Draft/Pending State
findings.description: The Charge schema defines a status enum including 'pending', but the code sets status to 'succeeded' immediately in create_charge. All write operations are committed upon execution with no reviewable intermediate state.
findings.gap: No draft/pending workflow exists. An agent creating a charge or refund commits it immediately — there is no mechanism for human review before finalization.
findings.recommendation: Implement a two-step charge flow: create_charge initially writes with status='pending', then a separate confirm_charge endpoint transitions to 'succeeded'. The schema already supports the 'pending' status value.

findings.title: Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates exist. All operations with valid authentication and authorization execute immediately. No operation-level flags to require human approval.
findings.gap: No mechanism to configure specific operations (e.g., refunds above a threshold) to require human approval before execution.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable approval thresholds for high-value operations. Operations exceeding thresholds write with status='pending_approval' and await a separate approve/reject endpoint call.

findings.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: Tests run offline against DynamoDB Local stub. CI pipeline provides automated testing. RUNBOOK references --config-env prod implying environment separation. No explicit staging environment IaC in the repository.
findings.gap: No staging environment definition in the repository. Agents cannot be tested against a production-equivalent environment from this codebase alone.
findings.recommendation: Add a samconfig.toml with staging environment configuration and document staging deployment procedure.

findings.title: Alerting on Error Rates and Latency
findings.description: RUNBOOK.md documents CloudWatch alarms (payments-5xx >1%, payments-idempotency-conflict >10/min, payments-ddb-throttle). These alarms are not defined in the SAM template.
findings.gap: Alerting configuration not codified in infrastructure-as-code. Alarms may drift or fail to be replicated in new environments.
findings.recommendation: Add AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm resources to infra/template.yaml for the three documented alarms.

findings.title: Concurrency Controls
findings.description: The idempotency mechanism in _idempotent_put performs a get_item followed by a put_item without a DynamoDB ConditionExpression. Two concurrent requests with the same idempotency key could both pass the existence check and both write, creating a TOCTOU race condition.
findings.gap: No DynamoDB conditional writes (ConditionExpression attribute_not_exists(pk)) on the idempotency record. The append-only design prevents data corruption for charge/refund items (each has a unique pk), but the idempotency guarantee has a narrow race window under concurrent agent instances.
findings.recommendation: Add a DynamoDB conditional put with attribute_not_exists(pk) on the idempotency record write. Catch ConditionalCheckFailedException and retry the read to return the existing result.

findings.title: Rate Limiting and Throttling
findings.description: No explicit rate limiting configuration in the SAM template. API Gateway applies default account-level throttling (10,000 req/s burst) but no per-client usage plan or per-method throttling is defined.
findings.gap: Default API Gateway limits are too generous to protect against a runaway agent loop. No per-client throttling exists.
findings.recommendation: Define an AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan with per-client rate limits in infra/template.yaml. Associate Usage Plans with API keys mapped to OAuth client_ids.

findings.title: Blast Radius and Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits exist. An agent can issue unlimited charges or refunds at machine speed. The only protection is API Gateway's default throttling (traffic rate), which does not cap business-domain impact.
findings.gap: No maximum charges per hour, no maximum refund amount per session, no spend caps per agent identity.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable per-client transaction limits (max_refunds_per_hour, max_charge_amount_per_session) enforced at the handler level before writing to the ledger.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, or machine-readable specification exists. Endpoints defined only in PHP code.
findings.gap: No machine-readable API spec. Agent tool generation requires manual authoring.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting all REST endpoints.

findings.title: Limited Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses return JSON with error field and HTTP status codes. No error code taxonomy, no retryable indicator, no field-level detail.
findings.gap: No structured error codes or retry classification.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error format with error codes and retryable boolean.

findings.title: Coarse-Grained Permissions
findings.description: The application has only two roles: admin and customer. No mechanism exists to create a scoped agent identity with read-only access to specific resources.
findings.gap: Binary role model. Cannot scope agent to specific resource subsets.
findings.recommendation: Implement granular RBAC with agent-specific roles and configurable endpoint access.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: Authorization checks are role-level only. No action-level differentiation within roles — an admin can perform all operations with no distinction between read, write, and delete.
findings.gap: No ABAC or fine-grained action permissions.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level permission checks on each endpoint.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No JWT/OAuth token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows, no identity propagation. PHP sessions only.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange or delegation mechanism.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credential Fallbacks
findings.description: Hardcoded fallback credentials in code (ecommerce_user/ecommerce_pass). No Secrets Manager or Vault integration. No rotation mechanism.
findings.gap: No secrets management system, hardcoded defaults in source.
findings.recommendation: Integrate AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove hardcoded credential fallbacks.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke an individual agent identity. Only session_destroy() on logout.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without disrupting the entire platform.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-identity suspension with immediate effect on active sessions.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction middleware. PHP error logging enabled. Exception messages could leak connection strings or user data. No log scrubbing or masking.
findings.gap: No PII redaction in logging pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Implement a logging abstraction with PII redaction for emails, names, and addresses.

findings.title: No Pagination Support
findings.description: API endpoints return all records without pagination, filtering, or sorting.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets. Agents receive all records regardless of need.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination parameters (limit, offset) to all list endpoints.

findings.title: Minimal Input Validation
findings.description: PDO prepared statements prevent SQL injection. Basic null checks on user creation. No schema validation framework or structured validation error responses.
findings.gap: No systematic input validation or structured validation errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON schema validation middleware with field-level error responses.

findings.title: Limited Temporal Metadata
findings.description: created_at/updated_at fields exist but no timezone normalization documented and no freshness signaling headers.
findings.gap: No freshness indicators or timezone documentation.
findings.recommendation: Normalize to UTC ISO 8601 and add Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No API versioning, no schema registry, no changelog, no contract tests, no breaking change detection.
findings.gap: Agent tool bindings break silently on any API change.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and contract tests.

findings.title: IaC Without Governance Controls
findings.description: CloudFormation IaC exists but no drift detection, no review process evidence, no change management.
findings.gap: Infrastructure governance incomplete — IaC exists without drift detection or review enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Enable AWS Config drift detection and require PR reviews for IaC changes.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Deployment is manual via deploy.sh (docker-compose up).
findings.gap: No automated testing, no contract validation, no deployment automation.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No deployment rollback mechanism. Manual docker-compose deployment with no automated recovery.
findings.gap: Cannot roll back broken deployments affecting agent-facing APIs.
findings.recommendation: Configure App Runner automatic rollback on health check failure.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests exist. No PHPUnit, no test directories, no API test suites.
findings.gap: No tests. API behavior changes cannot be caught by automation.
findings.recommendation: Implement API integration tests with PHPUnit or Newman.

findings.title: Approval Gates Not Configurable
findings.description: Approval gates exist for returns and order validation but are hardcoded. Cannot dynamically add approval requirements to other operations.
findings.gap: Approval gates not configurable by operation type. Cannot extend to new operations without code changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement a configurable approval framework where operation types can be flagged as requiring human approval based on rules.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no structured JSON logging, no correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated requests cannot be traced through the system.
findings.recommendation: Integrate AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry with structured JSON logging.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms for API error rates or latency. Only RDS Enhanced Monitoring configured.
findings.gap: No alerts for API degradation that would affect agents.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms for App Runner HTTP error rates and P99 latency.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags. Concurrent agent requests could create race conditions on order status updates.
findings.gap: No concurrency control mechanism for concurrent write operations.
findings.recommendation: Add version columns to orders table and implement optimistic locking with conflict detection.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No API-layer rate limiting. WAF has IP whitelisting but no rate-based rules. No application-level throttling.
findings.gap: No protection against runaway agent loops at any layer.
findings.recommendation: Add WAF rate-based rules and application-level per-caller throttling.

findings.title: No Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. No maximum records per operation, no spend caps, no bulk operation size limits.
findings.gap: No business-domain caps on agent operation scope.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller transaction limits for high-impact operations.

findings.title: No machine-readable API specification
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — machine-readable spec is not applicable. The system is a desktop application with no callable API surface.
findings.gap: No API surface to describe with a machine-readable specification.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification when building the API layer.

findings.title: No structured error responses
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — structured error responses are not applicable. Errors are displayed via MsgBox to desktop users.
findings.gap: No HTTP/RPC surface for structured errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error responses when building the API layer.

findings.title: No idempotent write operations
findings.description: No API endpoints exist for agents to call. Direct database INSERTs have no idempotency mechanism. Surface-flag calibration: has_http_rpc_surface=false — no agent-callable surface.
findings.gap: No idempotency support, but no API surface for agents either.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency keys on all write endpoints when building the API layer.

findings.title: No identity propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation. System uses Environ("USERNAME") as simple attribution. has_auth_surface=false — system does not issue or enforce identities.
findings.gap: No identity propagation mechanism exists.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 on-behalf-of flows in the new architecture.

findings.title: Data residency — on-premises, minimal PII
findings.description: Data resides on-premises on a single Windows file server. No cross-region replication, no cloud data movement. Minimal PII (customer names and Windows usernames). No sovereignty concerns with current deployment.
findings.gap: No data residency documentation, but on-premises storage has no current sovereignty concerns.
findings.recommendation: Document residency requirements before cloud migration.

findings.title: No logging exists — PII-in-logs not applicable
findings.description: System does not log user data and has no logging infrastructure. has_logging_of_user_data=false. PII-in-logs risk is not applicable.
findings.gap: Not applicable — no logging exists.
findings.recommendation: When implementing logging, include PII redaction from the start.

findings.title: No selective query support — no API surface
findings.description: No API endpoints exist with pagination/filtering. Desktop application uses direct SQL queries. No HTTP/RPC surface for agents to query.
findings.gap: No pagination/filtering at an API layer.
findings.recommendation: Implement cursor-based pagination and configurable filters on all query endpoints.

findings.title: No infrastructure governance — no agent-facing surface
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface and no auth surface. Desktop app with manual file server administration. No IaC, but no agent-facing integration surface requiring governance.
findings.gap: No IaC, but no agent-facing surface requiring governance.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure as code when building the cloud service.

findings.title: No CI/CD — no HTTP surface
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API contract testing not applicable. No CI/CD pipeline exists at all.
findings.gap: No CI/CD, but no API to contract-test.
findings.recommendation: Build CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing when creating the service layer.

findings.title: No rollback capability — no deployed HTTP surface
findings.description: No deployed HTTP/RPC surface to roll back. Manual EXE distribution with no deployment automation.
findings.gap: No rollback, but no deployed API surface.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green deployment with automatic rollback in cloud architecture.

findings.title: No encryption at rest
findings.description: Access .mdb uses database password (trivial obfuscation, not real encryption). On-premises file format predates modern encryption standards.
findings.gap: No real encryption at rest.
findings.recommendation: Enable KMS encryption on all data stores when migrating to cloud.

findings.title: No tracing or structured logging
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface for agents. No logging or tracing exists at all. has_http_rpc_surface=false — tracing not applicable for desktop app.
findings.gap: No tracing or structured logging, but no agent request path to trace.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry and structured logging in new service architecture.

findings.title: No alerting — no HTTP surface
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface. No alerting configuration exists. has_http_rpc_surface=false — alerting on API error rates not applicable.
findings.gap: No alerting, but no API surface to alert on.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms when building the API layer.

findings.title: No concurrency controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls exist. Access .mdb corrupts monthly under concurrent writes. has_http_rpc_surface=false — no API surface for concurrent agent instances.
findings.gap: No optimistic locking or concurrency management.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking in the new service layer.

findings.title: No rate limiting — no HTTP surface
findings.description: System exposes no HTTP/RPC surface — API-layer rate limiting is not applicable.
findings.gap: No HTTP/RPC surface for rate limiting.
findings.recommendation: Include API Gateway throttling when building the API layer.

findings.title: No blast radius or transaction limits
findings.description: No transaction limits. Single-record INSERTs with no configurable limits. No HTTP/RPC surface for agents.
findings.gap: No per-agent transaction limits.
findings.recommendation: Build per-agent transaction limits into the new service layer.

findings.title: HTML Response Format Only
findings.description: Responses are HTML (server-rendered pages) and application/octet-stream for file downloads. No JSON or structured data format.
findings.gap: Not machine-parseable without HTML scraping.
findings.recommendation: Modernize to JSON API responses.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, SNS, EventBridge, SQS, Kafka, or CDC pipelines.
findings.gap: Agents cannot react to state changes proactively. Polling is the only option.
findings.recommendation: Consider EventBridge integration for document lifecycle events.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation or headers. No X-RateLimit-Remaining, no Retry-After headers, no API Gateway usage plans.
findings.gap: Agents have no visibility into rate limits and cannot self-throttle.
findings.recommendation: Implement rate limit headers when API layer is built.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, dashboards, profiling, or completeness monitoring for the documents dataset.
findings.gap: Agents may act on incomplete or stale data without awareness.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring (null rates, completeness) for the documents table.

findings.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
findings.description: Field names are semantically meaningful and human-readable: doc_id, title, category, uploaded_by, uploaded_on, filename. Positive signal.
findings.gap: None — positive signal for agent integration.
findings.recommendation: Maintain this naming convention in modernization.

findings.gap: No discoverable metadata about what data the system holds.
findings.recommendation: Document the data model and consider a lightweight data catalog.

findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on service feedback.
findings.recommendation: Implement rate limiting with standard headers when deploying behind API Gateway.

findings.gap: No data quality awareness for agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring as part of modernization.

portfolio_level_findings.title: Centralized Identity Plane
portfolio_level_findings.finding: No shared identity provider detected across the portfolio. 10 of 14 services have AUTH-Q1 as BLOCKER (no machine identity). The 2 read-only services and 2 modern services have partial identity but no shared centralized IdP.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Deploy a centralized Cognito User Pool or Okta tenant as shared IdP for all services. Federate all agent identities through this single provider.

portfolio_level_findings.title: Cross-Service Audit Correlation
portfolio_level_findings.finding: No shared trace ID propagation or centralized audit trail detected. 12 of 14 services have no structured logging. No shared CloudTrail trail or centralized log aggregation.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Implement centralized CloudWatch Log Group with shared trace ID headers (X-Amzn-Trace-Id) across all services.

portfolio_level_findings.title: Portfolio-Level Rate Limiting
portfolio_level_findings.finding: No shared API Gateway or WAF protecting the portfolio perimeter. Each service (where applicable) manages rate limiting independently, and most have no rate limiting at all.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Deploy shared AWS WAF with portfolio-level rate rules protecting all agent-facing endpoints.

portfolio_level_findings.title: Transitive Dependency Safety
portfolio_level_findings.finding: No explicit dependency_overrides provided. Dependencies inferred: legacy-storefront-rails likely depends on a payment gateway (SOAP call). modern-orders-service depends on a warehouse service. No Agent-Ready or Pilot-Ready service depends synchronously on a Not Agent-Integrable service based on available evidence.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Map explicit service dependencies to identify transitive blocker propagation risks.

portfolio_level_findings.title: Agent Identity Governance
portfolio_level_findings.finding: No centralized mechanism to suspend or revoke agent identities across all services simultaneously. 12 of 14 services have AUTH-Q7 findings. No portfolio-wide agent identity registry detected.
portfolio_level_findings.recommendation: Implement centralized agent identity registry with global kill-switch capability (e.g., shared Cognito app client management).
